summary: This round redesigns the change into two commands. `halo app remove` claims the record as `removing`, saves a frozen snapshot from the VM into the owner workspace, removes the VM, and restores the extension locally. `halo extension delete` removes local files, data and backups. The VM-before-save ordering is sound, but `ExtensionHost.delete` makes an untimed control-plane call inside the extension action queue, and an installed template copy can get stuck in `removing` if a reload runs between a failed final step and the retry. The coverage gate also fails with 21 uncovered lines.

findings.body: `delete` calls `this.remoteApps.list()` inside `actionQueue.run` and passes no abort signal. Lines 60-61 of this file state that control-plane lookups run outside the queue "so a slow control plane never blocks it", and `loadRemoteLinks` uses `AbortSignal.timeout(5000)`. Here, a slow or unreachable control plane blocks `halo extension delete` and also every queued extension operation (start, reload, publish, `prepareAppRemoval`) until the request fails. Do the lookup before entering the queue, or at least pass a timeout signal as `loadRemoteLinks` does. Then re-check the marker inside the queue.

`completeRemoval` moves the saved project into `.halo/extensions/<id>` before it removes the remote marker. If the marker `rm` fails, which the temp test treats as a normal retryable failure, or the process stops between these steps, the next `reload()` still sees a `remote` marker. Server start also calls `reload()`. `reload()` then runs `retireLocalCopies` and renames the restored source into `.halo/published-backups/<appId>/source`. For an ordinary publication, that rename fails because the original backup already exists. An installed template copy has no backup, so the restored source moves away. Every later `halo app remove` then fails at line 271 with "saved extension is missing", although the VM is already deleted, and the app stays in `removing` permanently. Make `reload` skip retirement while `.halo/app-removals/<appId>/ready` exists, or have `completeRemoval` recover a source that was moved into the backup.

The coverage gate fails, and these lines are uncovered: ExtensionHost 375-376, 456, 491, 517, 521, 576-577, 592-593, 617; AppPublication 216, 230, 250, 271, 297, 301, 320, 327, 335; AppService 289. The VM-side removal guards (375-376 install, 576-577 writeSource, 592-593 execSource, 456 sandbox snapshot failure) keep the saved snapshot authoritative, so they must be tested. The new `sandboxTest` seems to target them, but the report shows them uncovered; confirm that it runs and rerun coverage. Also add temp tests or accepted exemptions for: the unreachable VM (AppService 289); the marker/app-ID mismatch in `completeRemoval` (230); the missing saved extension (271); invalid or unreadable `.install-id` (297, 301); the backup-ID cycle (320); the remote-apps lookup failure and the apps-still-listed refusal in `delete` (517, 521); and the local start failure after restore (491).

testRequests.target: ExtensionHost.ts:375-376, 456, 576-577, 592-593 — app VM refuses install, writeSource and execSource after snapshotForRemoval, and a sandbox snapshot failure is returned
testRequests.rationale: These guards keep the saved snapshot authoritative. The report shows them uncovered.

testRequests.target: AppService.ts:289 — remove with an unreachable VM keeps the VM and leaves the record in removing
testRequests.rationale: An uncovered refusal that prevents removing a VM before its content is saved.

testRequests.target: AppPublication.ts:230, 271 — completeRemoval refuses a mismatched marker and a missing restored source, including after reload() runs between a failed marker removal and the retry for a remote marker without a backup
testRequests.rationale: This is the recovery path behind F7.

testRequests.target: ExtensionHost.ts:517, 521 — extension delete refuses while the app is still listed and when the remote-apps lookup fails
testRequests.rationale: Prevents deleting the only saved copy while app removal is unfinished.

testRequests.target: AppPublication.ts:297, 301, 320 — invalid or unreadable .install-id and a backup-ID cycle
